summary: Join our Real Estate Finance and Capital Markets training course to gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills. Propel your career to new heights!
lede: Real estate capital markets connect property investment plans with debt and equity funding, guided by cash flows and risk. For professionals in property finance, acquisitions, portfolio management, and development funding, the course covers cash flow and return modeling, debt sizing, and comparisons of financing structures. Participants also practice refinancing analysis and preparing investment committee briefs that explain assumptions and capital strategy.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you work in property finance, acquisition underwriting, capital raising, portfolio management, or development funding and need practical control over financing decisions.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with Microsoft Excel or equivalent spreadsheet software installed. A working knowledge of real estate finance terms, property valuation basics, and investment analysis is expected before you attend.
